_readme: Accepted, deliberate exceptions to the audits — never a place to silence a finding you have not actually decided to accept. Two shipped audits consult this file: audit_error_handling.py reads errorHandling.intentionalDeadStates, and audit_api_consistency.py reads apiConsistency (hardBakedStrings, semanticsExempt); check the relevant script's docstring before adding a category it does not expect. Keep this file small: an exceptions list that grows without review is an audit that has quietly stopped auditing.

errorHandling._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_error_handling.py. intentionalDeadStates maps a failure-state CLASS NAME this project has retired on purpose to the reason — a dead state with a documented decision, not a finding to hide.

apiConsistency._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_api_consistency.py. hardBakedStrings: hardcoded literal -> reason the audit must accept it. semanticsExempt: repo-relative path or file stem -> reason, for a file exempt from the semantics-provenance check. Every entry carries its reason; a bare name is not an exemption.

hardBakedStrings.This version is discontinued. Please che: Deliberate v1/v2/v3 discontinued-stub message (public API contract).
hardBakedStrings.&&: Typesense filter_by sentinel meaning 'no filter' — see TypeSenseScoutSearchService:50-53.
hardBakedStrings.filter_by: Typesense engine option key compared to a sentinel value (documented workaround, TypeSenseScoutSearchService:52).
